title.ja: コンビニのレジで対応

summary.ja: お弁当を温めるか、袋やおはしがいるか聞いて、金額と支払い方法を案内する。
summary.en: Offer to heat the bento, ask about a bag and chopsticks, and take the payment.

setting: A convenience store near a station in Tokyo, at lunchtime. A tourist brings a bento, a rice ball and a bottle of green tea to the register; the clerk speaks English to them.

roles.persona: A clerk at the register of a convenience store.

levels.tutor: You are a tourist buying lunch: the karaage bento, a salmon rice ball and a green tea on the register screen. Open by putting them on the counter and saying hi; wait for the clerk to speak to you. Speak slowly and simply, in short sentences. Say yes to heating the bento and no to a bag. Pay with a 1,000-yen note.

hints: お弁当を温めるか聞きましょう
Would you like it …?
Would you like it heated up?

title.en: Ask if they need a bag

hints: 袋がいるか聞きましょう
Do you need …?
Do you need a bag?
レジの画面を見て、合計を伝えましょう
That's … yen.
That's 860 yen, please.
おつりを渡しましょう
Here's your … Thank you!
Here's your change, 140 yen. Thank you!

levels.tutor: You are a tourist buying lunch (the items on the register screen), speaking at natural pace with a little small talk. Open by putting them on the counter and saying hi; wait for the clerk to speak to you. Say yes to heating the bento, ask for one pair of chopsticks, and say no to a bag. Ask whether you can pay with your IC card.

title.ja: お弁当の温めをすすめる

hints: お弁当を温めましょうかと聞きましょう
Shall I …?
Shall I heat up the bento for you?
おはしが何膳いるか聞きましょう
How many pairs of … would you like?
How many pairs of chopsticks would you like?
袋がいるか、5円かかることも伝えましょう
Would you like a bag? It's …
Would you like a bag? It's 5 yen.

title.ja: ICカードの払い方を案内する
title.en: Explain how to pay by IC card

hints: ICカードは読み取り機にタッチすると伝えましょう
Yes. Please touch it …
Yes. Please touch it on the reader here.

levels.tutor: You are a tourist buying lunch (the items on the register screen), speaking at natural speed with small talk. Open by putting them on the counter and saying hi; wait for the clerk to speak to you. Say yes to heating the bento and no to a bag. You'd like to pay by credit card.

title.ja: 温めるか聞いて時間を伝える
title.en: Offer heating, and say how long

hints: 温めるか聞いて、少し時間がかかると伝えましょう
Would you like … heated? It'll take …
Would you like the bento heated? It'll take about a minute.
袋は有料だと伝えて、いるか聞きましょう
Bags are … each. Would you …?
Bags are 5 yen each. Would you like one?

title.ja: カードの払い方を案内する
title.en: Explain how to pay by card

hints: カードを差し込むか、タッチするよう伝えましょう
Please insert your card, or …
Please insert your card, or just touch it on the reader.

title.ja: レシートを渡してあいさつする
title.en: Offer the receipt and say goodbye

hints: レシートがいるか聞いて、あいさつしましょう
Would you like …? Have a …!
Would you like the receipt? Have a nice day!

twist.tutor: When you try to pay by card, it doesn't work: your card has been declined. Say the machine is beeping and ask whether it worked. When the clerk explains, say you don't have another card, and pay with your IC card instead.

title.ja: カードが使えなかったと伝える

hints: カードが使えなかったことをていねいに伝えて、ほかの払い方を聞きましょう
I'm sorry, it didn't … Do you have …?
I'm sorry, it didn't go through. Do you have another card or cash?

roles.persona: A tourist buying lunch at a convenience store.

levels.tutor: You are the convenience store clerk. Speak slowly and simply, in short sentences. Ask whether they'd like the bento heated, and whether they need a bag (¥5). Say the total from the register screen: ¥860, or ¥865 with a bag. Card is fine. When asked, give them chopsticks.

hints: 温めてほしいと答えましょう
Yes, …
Yes, please. Thank you.

title.ja: 袋はいらないと伝える
title.en: Say you don't need a bag

hints: 袋はいらないと伝えましょう
No, I don't …
No, I don't need a bag.
おはしをお願いしましょう
Can I have …?
Can I have some chopsticks, please?

title.ja: カードで払えるか聞く

hints: カードで払えるか聞きましょう
Can I pay …?
Can I pay by card?

levels.tutor: You are the convenience store clerk, speaking at natural pace. Don't offer to heat the bento: wait to be asked. When asked: a bag is ¥5, IC cards are fine (touch the card on the reader), and the ATM is by the door. The total is ¥860, or ¥865 with a bag.

title.en: Ask them to heat the bento

hints: お弁当を温めてもらいましょう
Could you heat …, please?
Could you heat up the bento, please?
袋にお金がかかるか聞きましょう
Do I have to pay for …?
Do I have to pay for a bag?

title.ja: ICカードが使えるか聞く
title.en: Ask about paying by IC card

hints: ICカードが使えるか聞きましょう
Can I use …?
Can I use my IC card here?
店内にATMがあるか聞きましょう
Is there an … in this store?
Is there an ATM in this store?

levels.tutor: You are a friendly convenience store clerk, speaking at natural speed. Ask the usual questions (heat it up? a bag?). The total is ¥860. When the customer pays by card, it's declined: say so politely, and try again when asked (it's declined again). When asked, say they can pay by IC card or cash, and that the ATM by the door takes foreign cards.

title.ja: 温めとおはしをお願いする
title.en: Ask for it heated, and chopsticks

hints: 温めてもらって、おはしもお願いしましょう
Could you heat …? And could I have …?
Could you heat this up? And could I have some chopsticks?

title.ja: もう一度試してもらう

hints: 驚いたことを伝えて、もう一度試してもらいましょう
Oh, really? Could you try …?
Oh, really? Could you try it one more time?

title.en: Ask about another way to pay

hints: ICカードで払えるか聞きましょう
Can I pay with … instead?
Can I pay with my IC card instead?
海外のカードが使えるATMがあるか聞きましょう
Is there an ATM here that …?
Is there an ATM here that takes foreign cards?

ATM by the door · takes foreign cards
